title: A separated etale morphism is finite etale on a constructible stratification
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $f:V\to Y$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] which is separated and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] (since $Y$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, $f$ is quasi-compact exactly when $V$ is quasi-compact). Then there exists a finite partition $Y=\coprod_rY_r$ into pairwise disjoint subsets $Y_r$, each locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset] and constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] and given the structure of a subscheme (an immersion $Y_r\to Y$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with image $Y_r$), such that each base change $V\times_Y Y_r\to Y_r$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category].

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ (more-morphisms-lemma-stratify-flat-fp-qf), together with Etale Morphisms: etale implies flat, locally of finite presentation and quasi-finite; the finite locally free strata are finite etale after base change

proof.text: By [def-weil-etale-morphism], $f$ is flat, locally of finite presentation and unramified. An unramified morphism is quasi-finite at every point, i.e. locally quasi-finite [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-quasi-finite-at-points]. Since $f$ is moreover quasi-compact, it is quasi-finite [pqf-lem-qf-locqf-qc]. Together with the hypothesis that $f$ is separated, $f$ is flat, locally of finite presentation, separated and quasi-finite.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas Tag 02GR (etale is locally of finite presentation), 02GS (etale is flat), 03WS (etale is locally quasi-finite), 01TJ (quasi-finite = locally quasi-finite + quasi-compact); applied as in Etale Cohomology Lemma 03S9, proof, first sentence

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-fp-qf-stratification] to $f$: there are closed subsets $\emptyset=Z_{-1}\subseteq Z_0\subseteq Z_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq Y$ such that $Y_r:=Z_r\setminus Z_{r-1}$ ($r\ge0$) are pairwise disjoint with union $Y$, for every morphism $g:T\to Y$ the projection $V\times_YT\to T$ is finite locally free of degree $r$ if and only if $g(T)\subseteq Y_r$, and every inclusion $Y_r\to Y$ is quasi-compact.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-qf), statement

proof.text: Only finitely many $Y_r$ are nonempty. Since $f$ is quasi-compact and $Y$ is quasi-compact, $V$ is quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] (2). As $f$ is locally quasi-finite (step 1), [lem-weil-pbc-lqf-qc-source-bounded-fibres] gives an integer $n$ such that every fibre $V_y=V\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)$ is a finite $\kappa(y)$-scheme with $\dim_{\kappa(y)}\Gamma(V_y,\mathcal O_{V_y})\le n$. If $y\in Y_r$, apply the universal property of step 2 to $g:T=\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)\to Y$, whose image $\{y\}$ lies in $Y_r$: then $V_y\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)$ is finite locally free of degree $r$, so by [def-pc-finite-locally-free] (fibre over the unique point of $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)$, which is $V_y$ itself) $r=\dim_{\kappa(y)}\Gamma(V_y,\mathcal O_{V_y})\le n$. Hence $Y_r=\emptyset$ for $r>n$, $Z_n=Y$, and $Y=Y_0\sqcup\cdots\sqcup Y_n$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ, proof, first paragraph (fibres universally bounded by Morphisms Lemma 03JA), and the universal property applied to the points Spec kappa(y)

proof.text: Each $Y_r$ is locally closed and constructible. Since $Y$ is quasi-compact and $Y_r\to Y$ is quasi-compact (step 2), $Y_r=Y_r\cap Y$ is quasi-compact. For $-1\le r\le n$ put $U_r:=Y\setminus Z_r=Y_{r+1}\cup\cdots\cup Y_n$ (so $U_{-1}=Y$, $U_n=\emptyset$): it is open, as $Z_r$ is closed, and quasi-compact, as a finite union of quasi-compact subsets. The underlying space of the qcqs scheme $Y$ is spectral [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-scheme-spectral], so every $U_r$ is a retrocompact open subset [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-open-retrocompact-iff-quasi-compact]. Then $Y_r=U_{r-1}\cap(Y\setminus U_r)$ is of the form $U\cap(Y\setminus U')$ with $U,U'$ open and retrocompact, hence constructible by [def-weil-constructible-subset]; it is the intersection of the open $U_{r-1}$ with the closed $Z_r$, hence locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset], and closed in $U_{r-1}$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ, statement (Moreover-part: the inclusions S_r -> S are quasi-compact) and proof, second paragraph ('elementary topology'); constructibility by Topology Lemma Tag 005H's definition of constructible sets

proof.text: Give each $Y_r$ a subscheme structure: $Y_r$ is a closed subset of the open subscheme $U_{r-1}\subseteq Y$ (step 4), so by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-closed-subscheme] there is a closed immersion $Y_r\to U_{r-1}$ with image $Y_r$ (for instance the reduced induced structure); composed with the open immersion $U_{r-1}\to Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion] it is an immersion $i_r:Y_r\to Y$ with image $Y_r$ [def-weil-closed-immersion].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), statement ('partition by constructible locally closed subschemes'); the subscheme structure is the step the source leaves implicit

proof.text: For each $r\le n$ apply the universal property of step 2 to $g=i_r:T=Y_r\to Y$, whose image is $Y_r$: the projection $V\times_YY_r\to Y_r$ is finite locally free of degree $r$, in particular finite [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. It is etale as a base change of the etale morphism $f$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]. Hence it is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $Y=Y_0\sqcup\cdots\sqcup Y_n$ (step 3) is the required finite partition by constructible locally closed subschemes (steps 4 and 5).

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9, proof, first sentence ('If U -> X is separated, then this is More on Morphisms, Lemma 07RZ'), with Morphisms Lemma Tag 02GO (base change of etale)

split_report.summary: The statement lacked a quasi-compactness hypothesis: Stacks 07RZ needs f quasi-finite (= locally quasi-finite + quasi-compact), and without it the statement is false (V = infinitely many disjoint copies of Y = Spec k over Y: separated etale, no nonempty stratum over which V is finite). Added 'f quasi-compact' (equivalently V quasi-compact, Y being qcqs), which holds in every application in the citer lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratified-finite (U qcqs over qcqs X, and base changes of quasi-compact morphisms). Also made the subscheme structure explicit (immersion with image Y_r) and added the locally-closed-subset definition to stmt_deps. Proof in six steps: etale => flat, lfp, locally quasi-finite, hence quasi-finite; Stacks 07RZ (new unsplit node); finitely many strata via universally bounded fibres (Stacks 03JA, new unsplit node) and the universal property at points; constructibility and local closedness of the strata from quasi-compactness of the inclusions and the spectral topology of Y; reduced/closed subscheme structure; finite (finite locally free) and etale (base change, new Mathlib leaf 02GO = Etale.etale_isStableUnderBaseChange). Tags verified against tags/tags.

The statement delivered by F1 lacked quasi-compactness of f and was false (infinitely many copies of Spec k); the worker added the hypothesis; the citer lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratified-finite applies it only to quasi-compact morphisms.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_separated_stratified_finite {X U : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [QuasiCompact j] : ∃ S : LocallyClosedStratification X, (∀ i : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum i)) ∧ (∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFinite (pullback.snd j (S.immersion i)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd j (S.immersion i)))

reviewed_lean.note: Y qcqs -> [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (delivered QuasiCompact/QuasiSeparated (𝟙 Y) were vacuous, inferInstance); f etale/separated/qc -> [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [QuasiCompact j]; finite partition into locally closed subschemes with immersion of image Y_r -> LocallyClosedStratification X (F1/K1 spelling); constructible -> Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum i); V x_Y Y_r -> Y_r finite etale -> IsFinite ∧ Etale (pullback.snd j (S.immersion i))
